svg.title: W07: Decentralized handoffs collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Workflow · A² A1 · handoff role collaboration
Transfer control to another specialized agent.
Multiple peer agents can transfer control.
The active agent invokes a handoff target.
The target becomes active with declared history
Target identity and transfer trigger are
Control cannot cycle indefinitely or return
1 request(handoff) → 2 check(authority) → 3 transfer(control) → 4 preserve(context) → 5 restore(context) → 6 return(failure)
Evidence: 33/41 repositories, 29/36 families; 33 trajectories (15 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: History filters, target criteria, enable predicates, and cycle controls.
Negative control: A normal function call that returns to the caller is not a handoff.
